text.en:
Item (41), page 209, paragraph c, Title A—Buildings, Section four of Republic Act Numbered Sixteen hundred thirteen is amended to read as follows:
"(41) New Tanauan Municipal Building, Tanauan, Batangas—Construction and/or improvement ₱100,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1960.
